newsitem.title: GERMANY: German Bunds, Bobls end the day slightly easier.
newsitem.headline: German Bunds, Bobls end the day slightly easier.

text.p: The German debt market ended trade on Monday slightly easier and dealers said the lack of new factors to drive the market combined with the U.S. holiday to consign trade to narrow ranges.
The Bund future was slightly lower at 99.25 from 99.30 on Friday, but its closing value showed a recovery from an earlier low at 99.10 points.

The Bobl future suffered from heavy selling in cash market over the morning, which pushed it to a low of 103.88 points. It recovered over the course of the day and the contract ended the day at 104.03 points.
